title: SourcesItemCreatedPayload
description: sources.item.created v1 (OpenVibe.Sources server/items.js ingest → itemEvent). A successful fetch, or a manual entry, produced an item Sources had not seen (revision 1). A summary only: consumers fetch the full sources.item@1 with sources.item.read. Envelope: subject { type: item, id: <item_id>, revision }, visibility internal, priority important, actor service:sources.

kind.description: article | url | sitemap | product | offer | review | record … (sources.item@1 kind).

retrieved_at.description: Last successful fetch (or manual entry) that contained the item.
